gates.stdout: PASS historical_74_reproduced: the registry at 74 evals reproduces the committed eval-1 figures byte for byte from the run's own copy, with the renderer's single reported line naming its own out dir

PASS reconstructed_75_oracle_match: the one-eval reconstruction reproduces the committed eval-2 figures byte for byte, and the run's two registry copies differ in exactly the appended eval on receipt-figure-render

PASS authored_21_geometry: the authored 21-capability registry renders a byte-identical figure 1 and a figure 2 that is exactly the model geometry, one row taller, with the authored capability carrying zero counts

PASS historical_sidecars_accepted: the frozen checker accepts both committed historical sidecars — the 74-eval one against the frozen registry and the 75-eval one against its reconstruction — each in its single acceptance line
PASS fresh_sidecars_accepted: the frozen checker re-run by this gate accepts all 3 freshly rendered sidecars against the registries the run itself wrote (74/20, 75/20, 74/21)

PASS fresh_sidecar_reproduces_historical: both fresh sidecars are byte-identical to the committed historical sidecars modulo exactly the source field, whose value realpaths to the run's own registry copy under the pinned hash
PASS tampered_sidecar_bites: the tampered sidecar is caught by exactly the aggregate leg the model predicts, in one printed line, with the per-capability record left untouched
PASS stale_sidecar_reported: the stale 75-eval sidecar is reported in exactly the three ordered lines the model predicts, against the frozen 74 registry the case read
PASS capability_shift_bites: the capability-shifted sidecar is caught by the per-capability leg alone — same aggregate, exactly the two moved capabilities reported, in the frozen checker's one line

PASS degenerate_inputs_reported: both degenerate registries are reported honestly: the valid-but-empty one as a partial render (figure 1 on disk, no sidecar, the interpreter's own ValueError) and the truncated one as nothing written at all

PASS geometry_tracks_frozen_registry: all 3 rendered states have figure geometry equal to the model built from the registry each case itself read, with the drawn bar lengths tied to the recorded counts

PASS cap_count_does_not_move_geometry: adding a capability with no evals changes neither figure 1's bytes nor any drawn pixel of figure 2 — it adds exactly one 36-px row — while the 75th eval does move figure 1
PASS frozen_source_pinned: both frozen scripts are the pinned revisions on disk, the run wrote their identity into evidence/frozen.sha256, and all 10 executed cases ran those exact files

PASS artifact_identity_pinned: the run is an execution of this exact package revision, all 13 pinned fixtures agree byte for byte across the package, the run's work dir and the run's evidence copy, and the run's request is pinned by hash with every case reading the run's own fixture copy
